pytorch_task_v1.prompt_instructions: Implement this ML task as a SINGLE self-contained Python file (task.py). Include all required functions AND a complete `if __name__ == '__main__':` block that trains the model, evaluates on a validation split, prints standard metrics (MSE, R2, parameter accuracy where applicable), and asserts quality thresholds so the script exits non-zero on failure. Do NOT create separate test files or README. The script itself is the test.
evaluation_rules: The `evaluate()` function MUST compute and return standard metrics: MSE, R2 score, and any task-specific metrics on the VALIDATION data split.

The `if __name__ == '__main__':` block MUST: (1) train the model, (2) evaluate on BOTH train and validation splits, (3) print all metrics clearly, (4) assert quality thresholds (e.g., R2 > 0.9, MSE < threshold), (5) exit 0 on success or non-zero on failure.
Do NOT use a separate test file. All evaluation logic goes in main().

tasks.description: Implement a clean augmentation pipeline and run ablations (none vs light vs strong) to quantify impact on accuracy/robustness.

requirements.data: CIFAR10 or a small custom image folder; offline fallback supported.
requirements.training: Same model/config across ablations; only augmentation changes.
requirements.evaluation: Report clean accuracy + corruption/shifted-set accuracy (synthetic blur/noise) + calibration (ECE if available).
requirements.artifacts: Save example augmented images grid and ablation table to artifacts/.
requirements.validation: At least one augmentation setting improves robustness over baseline without collapsing clean accuracy beyond tolerance.

tasks.description: Fine-tune a YOLO-style detector (e.g., Ultralytics YOLOv8 or a lightweight detector) on a small dataset; compute mAP@50 and mAP@[.5:.95].

requirements.data: COCO subset or VOC; offline fallback: tiny detection dataset in YOLO format.
requirements.evaluation: Compute mAP metrics; report per-class AP for at least 3 classes when possible.
requirements.artifacts: Save qualitative predictions overlay images (>=20) to artifacts/preds/.
requirements.validation: mAP@50 must exceed a naive baseline (random/anchor-only) by a documented margin.

tasks.description: Fine-tune a DETR-family model with Hugging Face Transformers; implement proper box format conversions and evaluation with COCO API.

requirements.data: COCO-style annotations; offline fallback: synthetic boxes with known geometry.
requirements.training: Use gradient clipping + mixed precision when cuda.
requirements.evaluation: COCO mAP + IoU analysis; verify bbox conversion correctness with unit tests.
requirements.validation: COCO mAP improves vs frozen backbone baseline; bbox unit tests must pass.

tasks.description: Implement tiled inference for large images (e.g., aerial/street-view): split into overlapping tiles, run detector, fuse results with NMS/Soft-NMS/WBF.

requirements.data: High-res images or synthetic large canvas images with injected objects.
requirements.evaluation: Compare recall/precision vs non-tiling baseline; report runtime cost.
requirements.artifacts: Save tile-visualization overlays and fused predictions.
requirements.validation: Tiling must increase recall on small objects vs non-tiling baseline.

tasks.description: Fine-tune Mask R-CNN on a small dataset; evaluate both bbox AP and mask AP.

requirements.data: COCO instance segmentation subset; offline fallback: synthetic shapes with masks.
requirements.evaluation: Report bbox mAP and mask mAP; include qualitative mask overlays.
requirements.validation: Mask mAP improves vs pretrained-no-finetune baseline on the same validation subset.

tasks.description: Run monocular depth inference (MiDaS/DPT-like) and compute standard depth metrics; handle resizing and scale alignment.

requirements.data: NYU-Depth v2 subset or KITTI depth subset; offline fallback: synthetic depth planes.
requirements.evaluation: Compute abs-rel, rmse, delta1/delta2; document scale/shift alignment if using relative depth.
requirements.artifacts: Save depth colormap visualizations and error maps.
requirements.validation: Metrics must be finite; alignment must be verified with a unit test on synthetic planes.

tasks.description: Freeze a pretrained encoder and train a lightweight depth head; compare to full fine-tuning for speed/accuracy tradeoff.

requirements.training: Two runs: (A) frozen backbone, (B) partial unfreeze; same data split.
requirements.evaluation: Depth metrics + throughput (fps) on a fixed resolution.
requirements.validation: Frozen-head run must be faster; partial unfreeze must improve accuracy beyond tolerance.

tasks.description: Implement face detection inference + evaluation; handle confidence thresholds and NMS.

requirements.data: WIDER FACE subset if available; offline fallback: synthetic faces (cartoon circles) with known boxes.
requirements.evaluation: Compute precision/recall across thresholds; plot PR curve.
requirements.artifacts: Save detection overlays and PR curve plot.
requirements.validation: PR AUC beats a naive baseline; box format/NMS tests included.

tasks.description: Run keypoint estimation (OpenPose/HRNet/ViTPose-like) and evaluate with PCK or OKS-like metric on a small labeled subset.

requirements.data: COCO keypoints subset; offline fallback: synthetic stick figures with keypoints.
requirements.evaluation: Compute PCK@0.05 and PCK@0.1 (or OKS proxy); include joint-wise breakdown.
requirements.artifacts: Save skeleton overlays on images and metric table.
requirements.validation: Metric computation verified by unit tests on synthetic stick figures.

tasks.description: Build a simple MOT pipeline: detector outputs + IoU association + Kalman filter; assign track IDs over time.

requirements.data: MOT-style sequences; offline fallback: synthetic moving boxes.
requirements.evaluation: Compute MOTA/MOTP (or simplified IDF1 proxy) and track fragmentation stats.
requirements.artifacts: Save annotated video frames with track IDs and trajectories plot.
requirements.validation: On synthetic sequences, ID switches must be below a threshold; association tests included.

tasks.description: Add appearance embeddings (ReID) to improve association; ablate IoU-only vs IoU+ReID.

requirements.training: Optionally train a tiny embedding model on cropped identities; or use a pretrained embedder.
requirements.evaluation: Compare IDF1/ID switches between ablations; report runtime overhead.
requirements.validation: IoU+ReID must reduce ID switches on at least one sequence.

tasks.description: Implement a lightweight video classifier using frozen image encoder features (e.g., CLIP/ViT) + temporal pooling; evaluate accuracy/F1.

requirements.data: UCF101/HMDB51 subset or offline tiny labeled clips.
requirements.evaluation: Report accuracy + macro-F1; confusion matrix artifact.
requirements.validation: Must beat a random/majority baseline by a margin; deterministic evaluation with seed.

tasks.description: Benchmark inference using eager vs torch.compile vs ONNXRuntime (and optional TensorRT if available) for a detection or segmentation model.

requirements.benchmark: Measure latency, throughput, and memory; run warmup + timed runs; save benchmark JSON.
requirements.parity: Verify numerical parity on a fixed batch within tolerance (logits/boxes).
requirements.validation: At least one optimized path improves throughput/latency without breaking parity.

tasks.description: Evaluate a detector or classifier under corruptions (noise/blur/fog) and domain shift; produce a robustness report.

requirements.evaluation: Report metric degradation curves vs severity; include calibration drift if classification.
requirements.artifacts: Save robustness report JSON + plots; include a top-failure-case gallery.
requirements.validation: Report must be deterministic; includes tests that verify corruption pipeline correctness.

tasks.description: Fine-tune a compact encoder model (e.g., DistilBERT) for sentiment/topic classification using Hugging Face Trainer; evaluate with HF Evaluate metrics.

requirements.data: Use HF Datasets (e.g., SST-2 or AG News). If offline, fall back to a tiny bundled JSONL dataset with same schema.
requirements.training: Use Trainer with gradient accumulation and early stopping; log train/eval metrics each epoch.
requirements.evaluation: Report accuracy + macro-F1 via HF Evaluate; include confusion matrix artifact (png).
requirements.validation: Must beat a majority-class baseline by a clear margin; exit_code=0 only if threshold met.

tasks.description: Compare padding strategies and dynamic packing for efficiency: measure tokens/sec and GPU memory impact; ensure metric parity within tolerance.

requirements.data: Any HF text dataset; if offline, synthetic paragraphs with variable lengths.
requirements.training: Run 2 short training runs: (A) padded batches, (B) packed sequences / dynamic padding.
requirements.benchmark: Report throughput (tokens/sec) and peak memory; save plot (png).
requirements.validation: Packed/dynamic run must be faster OR use less memory; accuracy/F1 drop must be within tolerance.

tasks.description: Fine-tune a small seq2seq model (e.g., T5-small) for summarization; evaluate ROUGE with HF Evaluate.

requirements.data: Use a summarization dataset (e.g., CNN/DailyMail subset) or offline tiny summarization pairs.
requirements.evaluation: Compute ROUGE-1/2/L using HF Evaluate; save sample generations to artifacts/samples.txt.
requirements.validation: ROUGE must improve vs zero-shot baseline or vs a trivial baseline (lead-3).

tasks.description: Fine-tune a tiny instruct or base LLM (<= ~1.5B) on a small instruction or text corpus; track perplexity and generation sanity checks.

requirements.model: Use a small model such as TinyLlama (1.1B) or Qwen2.5-0.5B-class models if available.
requirements.evaluation: Report train/eval loss + perplexity; include a deterministic generation test (fixed prompt + seed).
requirements.artifacts: Save generations for 10 prompts to artifacts/generations.jsonl.
requirements.validation: Perplexity must decrease; generation must be non-empty and free of NaNs/inf logits.

tasks.description: Apply LoRA adapters with PEFT to a tiny LLM; compare trainable parameter count and quality vs full fine-tuning (or vs frozen baseline).

requirements.training: Implement LoRA with rank/alpha/dropout as configurable hyperparams; log trainable params.
requirements.evaluation: Measure perplexity delta and simple generation quality checks; report adapter size on disk.
requirements.validation: LoRA run must achieve comparable eval loss to baseline within tolerance while training far fewer parameters.

tasks.description: Use Unsloth to fine-tune the same tiny LLM with LoRA and compare throughput + memory vs a standard Transformers/PEFT run.

requirements.training: Run (A) baseline PEFT+Transformers and (B) Unsloth LoRA on same data/config where possible.
requirements.benchmark: Report tokens/sec and peak VRAM; save benchmark table to outputs['metrics']['benchmark'].
requirements.validation: Unsloth run must show measurable efficiency improvement (speed and/or VRAM) while keeping eval loss close.

tasks.description: Perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on an instruction dataset using TRL SFTTrainer; implement chat templates and dataset formatting checks.

requirements.data: Instruction pairs (prompt/response). If offline, use a small curated set (>= 200 samples).
requirements.training: Use TRL SFTTrainer; log loss curves and save best checkpoint.
requirements.validation: Format validator: ensure every sample conforms to the expected chat/instruction schema; fail fast with sys.exit(nonzero) if not.

tasks.description: Train a reward model on preference pairs (chosen vs rejected) and verify it assigns higher reward to chosen on a held-out set.

requirements.data: Preference dataset (chosen/rejected). If offline, synthesize pairs with rule-based preferences.
requirements.evaluation: Report pairwise accuracy (% where r(chosen) > r(rejected)) and calibration stats.
requirements.artifacts: Save a small leaderboard of hardest examples (where model is wrong) to artifacts/hard_cases.jsonl.
requirements.validation: Pairwise accuracy must exceed a random baseline by a margin.

tasks.description: Run DPO fine-tuning starting from an SFT model; evaluate preference win-rate on a validation preference set.

requirements.training: Use TRL DPOTrainer on chosen/rejected pairs; implement beta as configurable hyperparam.
requirements.evaluation: Report win-rate proxy: fraction of validation pairs where model prefers chosen completion.
requirements.validation: DPO must improve win-rate vs the SFT-only checkpoint on the same validation pairs.

tasks.description: Run PPO (or GRPO where available) with a lightweight, transparent reward function (e.g., format compliance, keyword coverage) to teach the RLHF loop mechanics.

requirements.reward: Reward must be deterministic and explainable (no external judge required).
requirements.training: Use TRL PPOTrainer or GRPO trainer; log KL, reward, and length statistics.
requirements.evaluation: Before/after comparison on a fixed prompt set; show improved reward without degenerate collapse (e.g., empty outputs).
requirements.validation: Average reward increases vs pre-RL checkpoint; generation remains valid JSON/text per task spec.

tasks.description: Build a reusable evaluation script that computes perplexity and task metrics (ROUGE/BLEU where applicable) using HF Evaluate; includes regression tests to prevent metric drift.

requirements.evaluation: Use HF Evaluate for at least 2 metrics relevant to the task (e.g., perplexity + ROUGE or BLEU).
requirements.testing: Add unit tests for metric computation and deterministic batching (seed control).
requirements.artifacts: Save a single eval report JSON to artifacts/eval_report.json containing model id, dataset hash, metrics, and runtime info.
requirements.validation: Re-running evaluation with same seed yields identical metrics within tight tolerance.
